relations.subject: fts:legacy-index
relations.note: Condition: general/new index creation, as opposed to post bucket-to-collection-upgrade compatibility, for which the Legacy Index is retained.
relations.evidence: The above Legacy Index is used for compatibility after an upgrade from buckets to collections uses the old bucket style "default _mapping" which only works on the _default scope and _default collection where buckets are upgraded into. The preferred method as of version 7.0 is shown in Creating a Dynamic Index above.

notable_absence.finding: Prerequisites mention needing 'permission to log into the console, load sample data, create indexes, create search indexes, and perform searches' but name no specific RBAC privilege, only a generic pointer to the Authorization overview - consistent with the privilege-documentation gap seen elsewhere in fts/ (clone-index, edit-index, delete actions).

cross_component_finding: This quickstart guide bridges the fts/ component with n1ql/ (Search Functions), rest-api/ (Search API), and java-sdk/ (Java Search Overview / Searching with the SDK) - it is the most cross-component-linked page in this batch.
